messages:
rachael: opened PR #8471 with a focused change: add a tiny 'preflight' paragraph for Dedicated provisioning that clarifies isolation labels + SLA language. asking for quick eyes.

tom: will review. is this the short paragraph that mentions tenant_label and reserved-pool isolation?

rachael: yep. also included a one-line validation command and a sample tenant YAML so customers can copy it.

andre: small content suggestion: call out that 'isolation: reserved-pool' implies eviction risk during capacity shortages and link to the eviction policy page. current wording is a little soft.

rachael: good point. i made a note in the PR to add an inline link. can someone confirm the exact eviction doc path? last time it moved.

dev-doc-bot: FYI docs-lint found one markdown heading style issue in docs/dedicated/provisioning.md: H2 should use '##' not '==='

tom: i'll push a fix for the lint. also drafting a 2-row example table for cooldown presets (burst vs steady) since users keep asking about cooldown semantics.

rachael: perfect. table should be very short, e.g.: 'burst: cooldown 30s, min_instances 0, burst_capacity 2' vs 'steady: cooldown 300s, min_instances 2, stable_fill true'

andre: can we add a one-liner about SLA phrasing? propose: 'Dedicated SLA applies to provisioned capacity when isolation=reserved-pool; latency target applies to primary model variant; fallback to lower-cost variants may incur higher latency.'

rachael: added that sentence. kept it concise to avoid legalese.

tom: link fix + cooldown table + lint fix pushed. also updated the YAML snippet to include the new 'sla' block. snippet now: ```tenant:
  name: example-co
  tenant_label: example-prod
  isolation: reserved-pool
  sla:
    latency_target_ms: 150
    fallback: small-gpt-quantized
```

staging-bot: PR #8471 preview deployed: https://staging.docs.redwood-inference.com/dedicated/provisioning#preflight-checklist

andre: checked preview; links resolve correctly now. one more tiny nit: the validation command `rwdctl tenant validate` prints a warning if isolation is missing. suggest including expected output sample to reduce confusion.

rachael: added expected output example and consolidated commits. planning to squash into a single commit and request merge. target: merge before EOD.

tom: LGTM pending squash. i also added a comment suggesting a callout box for 'what to do if you see eviction warnings' but it's optional.

rachael: thanks all. merging after squash + smoke check. will DM if anything in post-merge preview looks off. :rocket:
